d: Aisha Tyler hosts another episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Jeff Davis and star guest, Golden Globe winning actress Rachel Bloom from My Crazy Ex Girlfriend.

Aisha Tyler hosts another episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Greg Proops and a special guest in the muscular form of star of TV's School of Rock Tony Cavalero.
Jonathan must choose between Scarface alley cat Wayne, lust-filled parrot Colin and bad mother Ryan in "Let's Make A Date". Guest Kearran Giovanni joins for a police edition of "Dubbing". (S11, E13)
Hollywood Director, Props, Song Styles, Dating Profile, Living Scenery.
Questions Only, Newsflash, Let's Make a Date, Hats, Props, Number of Words, Dead Bodies.

Aisha Tyler hosts another hilarious episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Jonathan Mangum and star guest from Back to the Future Lea Thompson.

A weird news bulletin sees anchor Colin joined by a lapdancer, Irish dancer & freak show owner. Star guest comedian & TV presenter Cedric the Entertainer dons some increasingly bizarre hats. (S3, E02)
Colin uses the force on Ryan & Jonathan during a galactic edition of "Hollywood Director". Plus, ever wondered what would happen if a dog went to therapy? Find out in "Scenes from a Hat". (S1, E11)
Popstar Jordin Sparks joins for some unforgettable improv chaos. Ryan acts out the film Titanic, Wayne goes through the entire bible, and Jordin & Wayne team up as a bickering R&B duo. (S12, E13)
'Film & Theater Styles'; 'Props'; 'That'll Be Charlie Now'; 'World's Worst'; 'Song Styles'; 'Alphabet'.
Joining for a host of brilliant improv games, Danish super model Nina Agdal is serenaded Latin Pop style by Wayne, and gives flamboyant wedding planner Ryan a helping hand. (S3, E17)
Colin gets bossy playing the "Hollywood Director" and there's a time-bending game of "Forward Rewind". Guest performers are Olympic synchronised swimmers Mary Killman & Mariya Koroleva. (S1, E05)
Clive Anderson is in the chair for the series of improvised mayhem alongside a top class selection of guests.
'March'; 'Alphabet'; 'Tag'; 'Props'; 'Party Quirks'; Film & Theater Styles'; 'American Musical.'
Coach Colin tries to teach pro-wrestler Wayne some new moves in "Forward Rewind". An emotional goodbye scene between father Ryan and son Colin quickly turns hilarious in "Whose Line". (S2, E24)
'Film & Theater Styles'; 'World's Worst'; 'Helping Hands'; 'American Musical'; 'Song Styles'.
Colin's farm gets weird & wild in "Hollywood Director", and we hear some inappropriate things to say at a wedding in "Scenes From A Hat". Guest is reality star Jack Osbourne. (S2, E10)
Aisha Tyler hosts another hilarious episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Jonathan Mangum.
Hollywood Director Colin brings sexiness, catwalk models & Spanish game shows to an FBI gun range scene. There's an exciting Indiana Jones themed scene in returning game 'Whose Line...'. (S3, E22)
'Scenes From a Hat'; 'Superheroes'; 'Song Styles'; 'Sound Effects'; 'News Report'; 'Party Quirks'; 'Bar Scene.'
'Authors'; 'Film & Theater Styles'; 'World's Worst'; 'Props'; 'Song Styles'; 'Party Quirks'; 'Gospel.'
Randy Jeff has to swipe left or right in "Dating App", and bizarre super powers appear in the rarely played "Superheroes". Ryan is sent out in the field to report from a horror movie. (S12, E22)
The performers go musical in "Song Styles" to welcome this week's special guest: Glee star Kevin McHale. Also played are the improv classics "Dubbing" and "Scenes from a Hat". (S1, E02)
A bizarre Scenes from a Hat sets up a plastic surgery Hoedown & songs from 'Aisha: The Musical'. Bachelor Jeff chooses from a munchkin bully, a blind gondolier & 'Chicken Man'...as you do. (S3, E24)
Matchmaking takes a weird twist in "Let's Make a Date", we see some dynamic decoration in "Living Scenery" & "Scenes from a Hat" delivers again. Guest is Walking Dead actress Lauren Cohan. (S1, E01)
Hilarious improv game show, hosted by Aisha Tyler. Regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles & Colin Mochrie are joined by guest performer Greg Proops & star guest Kat Graham (The Vampire Diaries). (S2, E01)
Questions Only, Quiz Show, Film Dub, Hats, Weird Newscasters, Party Quirks, Daytime Talk Show.
Colin directs a movie with "Jerry Springer Show" guests and in Bollywood style, then reports from a swamp full of frogs. Wayne and Gary sing songs of the spa. (S11, E08)
Top class guest performer Keegan-Michael Key joins Ryan in guzzling Italian food in a "gangstery" Helping Hands. Plus, the cast take a law-breaking beach stroll in Irish Drinking Song. (S3, E11)
Aisha introduces another collection of unseen material from past series', incl. a crazy edition of "Party Quirks" and an action-packed flamenco scene with celebrity guest Marisol Nichols. (S12, E02)

Film star & comedian Tiffany Haddish is in the hot seat for some improv hilarity, performing a raucous rap duet with Wayne, and getting messy in "Helping Hands" with nervous boyfriend Ryan. (S12, E11)
Wayne goes masochistic in another bizarre edition of "Weird Newscasters" & famous TV scenes get a naked reimagining in "Scenes from a Hat". Guest is 'The Big Bang Theory' star Kunal Nayyar. (S2, E16)
Mini-Me is in the building! Aisha Tyler hosts as regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles, and Colin Mochrie are joined by guest performer Nyima Funk and star guest Verne Troyer. (S2, E03)
Hollywood director Colin oversees a slasher movie using Spring Break, Vegas entertainers & opera. Summer & Winter Olympic star Lolo Jones shows her versatility whilst being dubbed by Colin. (S3, E05)
Enjoy another dose of musical improv, as Glee star Darren Criss guests. We get treated to an unusual "Greatest Hits" compliation and a nightmare for our "Hollywood Director". (S2, E04)

Aisha Tyler hosts another hilarious episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Heather Anne Campbell and star guest Tony Hawk, skateboarding legend.
Jack Osbourne returns and salsa dances with Wayne. Ryan and Colin do an Infomercial on overcoming fears and Nyima joins the boys for an Irish Drinking Song on pregnancy. (S12, E07)
'Scenes From a Hat'; ' Questions Only'; 'Superheroes'; 'World's Worst'; 'Props'; 'Scene to Music'.
